PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_REUSE_GATE.featureName: Isolated WORLD_OWNED Life Director V0 deterministic harness

currentProject.evidence: Existing Persistent Agent lifecycle, supply, recovery, quest runtime and Event Ledger/projection code are reusable; no Life Director runtime exists. Evidence: ops/ro-stack/persistent-agent, ops/ro-stack/quest-runtime/event-log.mjs, ops/ro-stack/sql/005-persistent-life.sql.

legacyProject.evidence: OpenKore harvested behavior contracts cover supply, recovery, quest, navigation and resume boundaries. Evidence: docs/openkore-harvest-registry.md sections A5 and A8.

reuseRegistry.reference: State-machine and behavior references are registry-backed; rAthena primitives remain authoritative and BehaviorTree.CPP is reference/reuse candidate only.

rAthena.evidence: rAthena remains world authority for character state, movement, supply effects, recovery and quest results; PoC emits no runtime mutation.

openKore.evidence: OpenKore is used only as preserved behavior reference; no OpenKore process, command or source is imported into the PoC.

externalEcosystem.reason: The PoC uses repository-local deterministic logic and does not adopt an external dependency.

genericOSS.reason: A dependency-free reducer is sufficient for the isolated deterministic phase.

PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_REUSE_GATE.whyNotReuse: The existing Persistent Agent owns execution and authoritative transitions, but it has no Life Director goal-stack decision contract. The PoC adds only a pure orchestration wrapper that reuses existing lifecycle semantics and emits no runtime commands.

registryUpdate.evidence: Registry-backed local primitives are reused; no external candidate or license fact changed.
